agents_needs_you.rule: The Agents that wait for the user: one per waiting session, folded to its parent; Persona conversations, quiet tasks' agents, muted agents, directory-hidden sessions and sessions whose only pending cards are held (delegating; a card its task's supervisor holds, a routed terminal question included, is in no row either) left out; a card on no session counts 1. The needs-you fixture's badge rule (expected.badge_rows).

inbox_unread.rule: Unread open action items, one per item: what every client's Inbox tab counts today.

inbox_action.rule: Open action items, read or not, one per item: what the manager tells the roster as inbox_needs_you (tellInboxNeedsYou).

todos_needs_you.rule: N: the to-dos in Needs you, each once, quiet ones and Can wait left out, a step with its parent (TodoCounts.needs_you).

persona_cards.rule: One per pending owner card on a Persona conversation or a quiet task's agent, by its asking session; muted, directory-hidden, delegating, supervisor-held and mirrored cards are excluded (D9 and D11).
